thread:
Eve: dropped a tiny prototype exploring a 'Save to vault' pattern for the one-time key reveal. trying to reduce friction but avoid people losing the key. mock: https://design.redwood.local/mock/save-to-vault.png

Liam:  nice direction. question: is 'Save to vault' mandatory or optional? some teams want to auto-save to their linked secrets manager.

Zara: If we auto-save, we must display the destination and let users opt out. default off for privacy. also show a small 'Saved to X' confirmation with link to the vault entry.

Kofi: accessibility & flow: when the key is created focus should move into the reveal panel. panel could offer three actions: Copy, Download, Save to vault (if linked). The Copy button must be keyboard-accessible and announce "Copied" via aria-live.

Eve: proposed copy for panel: heading: "Your API key — one-time view" body: "This value is shown once. Copy, download, or save to a connected secrets vault." CTAs: primary: "Download key", tertiary: "Save to vault" (if available), subtle: "I stored it" to acknowledge.

Liam: small UX nit: 'I stored it' can be easily missed. make that acknowledgement a full-width secondary button to avoid accidental dismissals. on mobile ensure it's visible without scrolling.

Zara: revoke flow: prefer inline soft-revoke (row becomes light banner with 'Access revoked — restore' for 20s). For high-risk keys (pinned to routes or marked 'critical') require extra confirmation: checkbox + type key name to confirm.

Kofi: about the undo window: 20s seems reasonable, but we should surface in the UI how many active clients might be impacted (best-effort). maybe "Affected: 3 routes" link to details. also if key is pinned show a small lock icon and tooltip "Pinned by route: payments-service".

Eve: bulk rotate idea: preview window before applying that lists old vs new key IDs and affected routes. add a small checkbox "Rotate secrets manager entries" to optionally update linked vaults. for >7 keys require typed confirm (enter ROTATE) to prevent mass outages.

Liam: copy proposals: primary create: "Generate API key" (verb-strong), secondary on reveal: "Download key" and a small CTA: "Save to vault". revoke confirmation heading: "Confirm revoke" body: "Revoking immediately blocks requests using this key." undo toast: "Revoked — undo" with action.

Zara: accessibility checklist: focus trap for drawer open, restore focus after panel close, aria-live polite for copy confirmations, assertive for immediate blocking revokes, ensure callout color contrast meets AA, and all danger actions last in DOM order. I'll add these to the PRD.

Kofi: mobile: overflow menu spacing fix + separate danger section. make sure danger actions are not first in the menu order. also enlarge hit targets to 44px.

UX-bot: automated run: focus-trap: PASS for drawer, focus-restore: WARN (needs implementation), aria-live for toasts: MISSING, color contrast for yellow callout: WARN. Uploaded artboard: save-to-vault-v1.fig (https://design.redwood.local/file/save-to-vault-v1)

Eve: thanks all. I'll iterate the prototype: add explicit vault opt-in, make acknowledgement a full-width button, include bulk rotate preview, and wire the aria-live regions. @Zara will you sanity-check the accessibility text once done?

Zara: happy to review. :thumbsup:
